concept_coverage_definition.normalization: NFKD, strip combining marks, casefold, collapse whitespace
concept_coverage_definition.stoplist: product.query.concept_coverage.STOPWORDS (generic function words, statute abbreviations, legal-form tokens in DE/FR/IT/EN)
concept_coverage_definition.matching: de-accented lowercase alnum prefix match (prefix = concept[:max(6, len-4)])
concept_coverage_definition.covered_semantics: >=1-of-set: a concept is covered iff >=1 bundle row's title/regeste/snippet/full_text/citation/decision_id contains the prefix as substring

authority_recall_definition.alnum_core: lowercase, drop non-alphanumeric, strip repeated leading court tokens (bgestger, bstger, bger, bge, bg)
authority_recall_definition.per_language: baseline channel only, per query language (fr/de/it)
authority_recall_definition.pass_semantics: >=1-of-set per authority set; partial pass names missing ids

latency_budget.rule: one search call must return in < 30s; the whole live pass must finish in < 240s

served_questions.query: Aktive Fürsorgepflicht des Arbeitgebers bei einer Kapitalverletzung: wie weit geht der aktive Eingriff, und welche Entscheidungen begrenzen ihn gegenüber einer blossen Überwachungspflicht?
Résiliation du bail pour défaut d'entretien du bailleur : jusqu'où va la jurisprudence, et quelles décisions distinguent le défaut d'entretien grave de la simple négligence ?
Responsabilità del medico per errore terapeutico: quale obbligo di diligenza e quale nesso causale devono essere dimostrati, e quali decisioni escludono la responsabilità?

frozen_reality_check_legs.note: no frozen controlling-authority set; recall not measurable

outcome_a_promote.frozen_authority_recall_improvement: at least TWO of the three failing fr/it cells (corporate-criminal-liability fr/it, business-judgment-rule fr/it, petty-theft-dismissal fr/it) must improve from 0 to >=1
outcome_a_promote.under_covered_reduction: at least TWO of the three served questions must reduce under_covered count
outcome_a_promote.no_regression: ALL gates that pass in accepted record 39117425713 must still pass

outcome_b_bounded_negative.condition: no in-budget deterministic expansion recovers the missing concepts or authority ids

non_vacuity.blanked_expansion: must score STRICTLY BELOW candidate on both concept-coverage and authority-recall axes
non_vacuity.shuffled_expansion: terms drawn from unrelated question must NOT raise coverage on target question

expansion_layer_contract.output: additive query_variants and provenance entries behind existing bundle seam
